leaders.name: Joel Pilger
leaders.proof_points: Impossible Pictures anchor accounts with DISH/Discovery; 12-year, multi-million account foundations.

leaders.name: Kevin Rapp
leaders.proof_points: Translates between creative and brand; AB testing, growth metrics, outcomes language; coaches studios to reframe pitches around business value instead of craft.

leaders.name: Justin Barnes
leaders.proof_points: Demonstrated how a creative studio can shift from vendor to strategic partner by sharing direct brand case studies in live session; proof that transparent show-and-tell outreach drives traction with brands.

leaders.name: Mitch Monson
leaders.proof_points: Arrow brand films → portal for 22 divisions → spillover into sports/aerospace/philanthropy → related win at Virgin Galactic.

course_structure.cadence: Week 0 kickoff + Weeks 1–8 workshops (live) + bonus/follow-up sessions
course_structure.deliverable_by_w8: Brand-direct roadmap: positioning → messaging → 3×3 targets → channel plan → outreach → 60-sec intro → first pilots scoped

sessions.title: Celebrate Wins / Maintain Momentum
sessions.purpose: Check-in after Week 8 to celebrate wins, reinforce momentum, and showcase long-term anchor account growth.
sessions.case_study: Arrow Electronics → brand library/portal (22 divisions) → expansion into sports, aerospace, philanthropy, Virgin Galactic.

sessions.title: Working Brand Direct
sessions.purpose: Deep dive on brand-optimized process, PAO messaging hygiene, and pilot scoping.

homework_conventions.naming: Homework for Week X (forward-looking to the next session).
homework_conventions.placement: Homework is a separate lesson in the platform.
homework_conventions.formatting: Short motivational opener + H3 with ✅ checklist (no numbered lists).

frameworks: Three Cs of Follow-Up (Curiosity → Conversation → Conversion)

case_studies.name: DISH Network (Impossible Pictures)
case_studies.summary: Began with a small edit; pitched a character system. VP discovered it internally → campaign scaled for years (30–40 spots).
case_studies.lesson: Anchor accounts fund creative risk; design for internal virality.

case_studies.name: Arrow Electronics (Sibling Rivalry, Mitch Monson)
case_studies.summary: From one-off spot to human brand film system + design thread; brand portal for 22 divisions; extended into sports/aerospace/philanthropy.
case_studies.lesson: Track org mapping; relationships compound even when champions leave.

case_studies.name: Virgin Galactic (via Arrow relationship capital)
case_studies.summary: Arrow credibility + relationships led to VG; site/newsletter/design assets; senior attention, small footprint.
case_studies.lesson: Use credibility and proof to enter new verticals; senior focus wins traction.

case_studies.name: MAKE (Danny Robashkin)
case_studies.summary: Beat larger studios (Buck, The Mill) by linking every creative choice to behavior change & outcomes.

case_studies.name: Polyester (Jeremy)
case_studies.summary: Expanded by reframing character resonance; priced by value; grew from production into broader strategy deliverables.
case_studies.lesson: Accounts grow sideways once trust is built.

case_studies.name: Catherine
case_studies.summary: Shifted to IP licensing posture, elevating studio value beyond commoditized services.

case_studies.name: David
case_studies.summary: Redirected blind RFPs into pilot projects with clear success criteria.
case_studies.lesson: De-risk engagements; pilots open the door to anchor accounts.

week_by_week.title: Your Studio’s Value
key_points: Reverse-engineer wins: why they chose you.
Value statement formula aligned to outcomes.

week_by_week.title: Articulate Your Value (Positioning + Persona)
homework_for_week_4: Define your unique value; rewrite one-liner.

week_by_week.title: Map the Landscape
key_points: Prioritize challenger brands; Rings of Proximity.
homework_for_week_5: Identify 1–3 stakeholders per brand (titles, orgs, ads activity).

week_by_week.title: Get On Their Radar (Midterm Check-Ins)
homework_for_week_6: Refine targeting and PAO case studies.

week_by_week.title: Flip the Script (Guest: Justin Barnes)
key_points: Sell a client-optimized process (speed, scale, consistency).
homework_for_week_7: ✅ Break each into clear action steps.
✅ Build an MVP (landing page, outreach test, sample case).

week_by_week.title: Nail the Follow-Up
key_points: 60-Second Intro coach notes: lead with differentiator, cut filler, benefits > features, clear next step.
homework_for_week_8: Prepare a 60-second intro for a dream brand (clarity, differentiation, value).

week_by_week.title: You’re In, Now Win (Capstone)
key_points: Feedback survey; schedule follow-up session ~3 weeks later.
homework_for_follow_up: Apply feedback from capstone to one live outreach/pilot.
Prepare a PAO mini-case from early results.

week_by_week.title: Celebrate Wins / Maintain Momentum (Mitch Monson)
key_points: Turn early wins into proof points.
Grow sideways inside brands (brand portal/library, adjacent divisions).
Track org changes; relationships > single champions.
homework_suggestion: Publish one PAO-style ‘win card’ (100–150 words) and share with cohort/buddy.
Update org-map for your top account (champions, successors, adjacencies).
